variants.headline: Home world raises its demands
variants.sub: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.
variants.body:
The home world has raised what it demands of the colony. The increase puts the relationship between distant authority and local obligation in focus. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the higher demand from any unreported account of its size, form or practical enforcement.

The gazette notes the increase as a change in the demands placed upon the colony. The existence of a higher requirement should be kept distinct from any assumption about its particulars. An administrative account is most useful when it describes the known obligation without supplying terms not established by the notice.

We regard {target} critically. A higher demand deserves more than automatic deference, and authority should not be excused from defending the fairness of what it asks other people to bear. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.sub: The home world is demanding more from {colony}.
